lines.text: The people complain, fire from the LORD consumes the camp's outskirts, Moses prays, and the place is called Taberah.
The Israelites weep for meat and remember the fish they ate freely in Midian.
Moses tells the LORD he cannot carry all these people by himself and asks Him to kill him.
The LORD tells Moses to bring seventy elders to the Tent of Meeting and puts some of the Spirit on them.
A wind from the LORD drives in quail, and the LORD strikes the people with a severe flood.
